pkgmetadata.longdescription: Rnote is a vector-based drawing app for sketching, handwritten notes, and annotating documents and pictures, built around pressure-sensitive stylus input. It offers fixed-page, continuous or infinite canvas layouts, a shape tool, PDF, bitmap and SVG import, export to SVG, PDF and Xournal++ (.xopp), and a CLI for automation. Written in Rust with GTK 4.
